item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of good prompts, and they all point at one skill: noticing before reacting. Ask whether this moment supports the life you're building. Check whether you're projecting or mind reading. Break a negative pattern with a little grace. You don't need more reminders. You need to answer one of them honestly, in real time. So today, when the next reminder pops up, pause for one breath and answer it out loud.
